sloka: तां तु दृष्ट्वा महाबाहो दारितां च स्तनान्तरे ।आशीविष इव क्रुद्धो निःश्वसन्नभ्यभाषथाः ।। ५.६७.७ ।।।।
transliteration: tāṁ tu dṛṣṭvā mahābāho dāritāṁ ca stanāntare ।āśīviṣa iva kruddho niḥśvasannabhyabhāṣathāḥ ।। 5.67.7 ।।।।

translations.english: "Seeing the blood flowing from her breasts you became furious like a hissing serpent and said:
